Firza has been working at **Hypefast** as a **Data Engineer** since **March 2025**. His role involves building and maintaining **data and Machine Learning (ML) infrastructure** for a **multi-brand consumer aggregator**, with a focus on **pipelines, recommendation systems, and AI-driven automation across 11+ brands**. 

Here are some key projects and responsibilities at Hypefast:

- **Smart Voucher Optimization System**: Created an end-to-end pipeline using **K-Means clustering** and **linear programming** for budget-constrained allocation, orchestrated via **Vertex AI** and **Cloud Composer**, achieving a **200× average monthly return on voucher budget per brand**.
  
- **ETL Pipelines**: Designed **L0–L2 ETL pipelines** ingesting order and customer data from **4 marketplace APIs** and **Google Sheets** to **BigQuery**, enabling unified analytics and reporting.

- **AI-Based OCR System**: Engineered an AI-based OCR system using **GCP Document AI** (evaluated against **Mistral AI**), automating **invoice and receipt processing**, reducing extraction time from **8 hours to 5 minutes (96× faster)** with **90%+ accuracy**.

- **Product Recommendation Systems**: Built and tuned **product recommendation systems** on **Shopee** using **TensorFlow/Keras**, **scikit-learn**, and **FastAPI** on **GCP**, driving **hundreds of millions of IDR per month in GMV**.

- **Metabase Dashboards**: Delivered **Metabase dashboards** for the **Finance**, **Data Science**, and **Business Operations** teams to monitor **catalog performance**, **advertising AI**, and **customer data platform**.

- **Social Media Scraping Integration**: Built a unified **SocialMediaService orchestrator** that walks the input CSV, dispatches to the right collector per row, normalizes the response, and writes a consistent layout (profiles vs content, partitioned by platform).

The **stack** used at Hypefast includes **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, **Composer (Airflow)**, **BigQuery**, **Vertex AI**, **Cloud Run**, **Compute Engine**, **Pub/Sub**, **Datastream (Change Data Capture / CDC)**, **Document AI**, **Flask**, **FastAPI**, **TensorFlow**, **scikit-learn**, **PostgreSQL**, **Metabase**, **Mistral AI**, **Jubelio (Omnichannel OMS)**, and **Mekari Jurnal**.

Firza's tech stack for data pipelines includes a wide range of tools and technologies, primarily focused on cloud platforms and data engineering. Key components include:

- **Cloud**: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS/ECR), GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Workflows, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, Composer), and Snowflake.
- **Data Processing**: PySpark, Hadoop, Hive, Impala, and Cloudera (CDH).
- **ETL & Data Modeling**: Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake for data modeling and transformation.
- **Streaming & Messaging**: Kafka for streaming data.
- **Infrastructure & DevOps**: Terraform, Docker, and Cloud Build for CI/CD.
- **Databases**: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB Atlas, and NoSQL.
- **BI & Visualization**: Looker Studio and Power BI for data visualization and dashboards.

These tools are used to build and manage large-scale data pipelines, ensuring efficient data ingestion, transformation, and visualization.
